title: Spain Votes With Vox as Kingmaker. In 1936 an Election Led to Civil War #shorts
description:
This weekend Spain votes in a snap election, and the far-right Vox party could decide who governs. In February 1936, Spain's Popular Front won a tight election; by July generals had risen against the government and the Spanish Civil War began.
